notes.content:

[/list]

Fixes

[/list]

notes.title: v1.09
notes.content:
Panel – Fight (Battle UI Enhancements):
[list]
[*] Added visual effect when player HP drops below a certain threshold
[*] Added visual effect when deck count is low
[*] Added effect during mission setup if a special condition is present
[*] Improved clarity when discarding upgrade cards
[*] Slightly adjusted positions for enemy-related UI elements
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a logic issue caused by triggering an enemy attack during the player's turn
[*] Fixed an issue where mission setup animation images might not display properly
[*] Fixed a bug where tooltips didn’t show when hovering over cards with the mouse
[*] Fixed a rare case where clicking a target that was already removed caused issues
[*] Fixed an error when a counterattack with a passive skill kills an enemy
[*] Fixed an issue where discarding a conditional encounter card could replace it with the wrong one
[*] Fixed a bug where the final mission used incorrect encounter cards
[*] Adjusted difficulty for Hunt Missions
[*] Game now autosaves after completing any run
[/list]

notes.title: v1.07
notes.content:
Update Notes

[list]
[*] You can now close the upgrade panel using the ESC key or the Cancel button
[*] Fixed an error triggered when dragging a used player card
[*] Fixed an issue where the card selection panel could sometimes block interactions
[*] Encounter deck now shuffles normally and no longer increases the danger level
[*] Fixed shortcut key movement issue where mission cards and player cards were not linked correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where a new story voice line could play before the previous one finished
[*] Fixed an issue where visual effects did not display correctly when adjusting values during setup
[/list]
